guidance.purpose: High-fidelity Figma design export for frontend implementation across web, mobile and desktop UI frameworks.
guidance.coordinateSystem: x/y are relative to the immediate parent; absoluteBoundingBox is page-space when available.
guidance.layerOrder: children are preserved in Figma layer order (back-to-front).
guidance.nodesShape: nodes is the root serialized node object; traverse node.children for the hierarchy.
guidance.assetStrategy: Asset paths in this JSON are relative to this screen folder. Prefer composed SVGs for decorative groups and individual SVGs for reusable icons.
guidance.implementationNote: Read developerSummary first, then assetIndex, then nodes. Use the exported PNG as the final visual reference.
guidance.sharedAssets: Identical files also used by other screens. Use relativeFromScreen from this JSON, or file from the package root. Screen-local assets remain available for standalone portability.

developerExport.visualReference: Use the exported 2× PNG as the final visual reference.
developerExport.layoutRule: Translate Auto Layout, FILL/HUG sizing, constraints and wrapping into the responsive layout primitives of the target framework instead of defaulting to absolute positioning.
developerExport.assetRule: Prefer SVG for implementation fidelity; use the matching PNG copy for quick visual inspection and QA. Prefer composed SVGs for decorative multi-vector groups.
developerExport.designSystemRule: Promote recurring colors, typography, radii, spacing and reusable UI patterns into the target project’s centralized design system/tokens.

implementationGuidance: Use this summary first, then inspect nodes for exact measurements and styling.
Do not reproduce Figma frame nesting one-to-one in code; build semantic, reusable frontend components.
Prefer Auto Layout/FILL/HUG/constraints over absolute positioning for responsive code.
Use composed SVGs for vector-only decorative groups and individual SVGs for reusable icons.
Centralize recurring colors, typography, radii and spacing candidates in the target project design system.
